title: well made, nice quality, very small
text: well made, nice quality, very small. I knew they would be smaller than a regular teaspoon but they are very small.  Baby feeding size.  Not the products fault but wanted to be sure everyone knew how small they are. You might know the size of expresso spoons, but in case you're like me and didn't know they are very small. :)

product_metadata.title: DAPRIL Cottage Stainless-Steel Espresso Spoons, Set of 8
features: Set of 8 graceful little espresso spoons
Crafted from premium 18/10 stainless steel with mirror finish
Classic style features oval bowl and bordered teardrop handle
Coordinates with Cottage place settings and serving flatware
Safe in the dishwasher for convenient cleanup
description: Henckels 8-piece Cottage espresso spoons are smaller in size and a perfect fit to use with your favorite demitasse cups. Made of 18/10 stainless steel for a great look and feel.

Simple and classic, Henckels Cottage flatware features a comfortable design with a touch of everyday elegance. Crafted from high-quality stainless steel, the design combines a teardrop handle with mirror polishing. A trim handle border completes the design.

A great addition to any stainless-steel flatware collection, the 18/10 stainless-steel Cottage espresso spoon is perfect for stirring sugar into a freshly pulled shot. The piece's oval bowl is substantial enough to be practical while the overall design preserves the petite charm of the demitasse spoon. Packaged in a set of eight, the spoon cleans up in the dishwasher and never needs polishing.
